text.tspan: PMDS prototype radio, step 3, sheet 3: the Teensy 4.1 and what connects to it
The Teensy 4.1's pins take 3.3 V only. Power the Si5351 board, the display and the encoder from the Teensy's 3.3V pin, never 5 V, so their pull-up
resistors stay at 3.3 V. Everything runs from the one USB cable. Audio Adaptor pins are joined to the Teensy pins with the same numbers.
I, from U5A pin 1 via 1 µF + 100 Ω (sheet 2)
Q, from U5B pin 7 via 1 µF + 100 Ω (sheet 2)
Si5351 0x60, display 0x3C. All share one bus.
The Si5351 board is on sheet 1.
